manifest: Monster House Highrise World - Asset Manifest
style_rule: UPDATED BY USER CORRECTION 2026-11-22: the house must match the ACTUAL Monster House film house (~95% replica) - see repo/00-reference/REFERENCE.md, which is now the authority for the facade and yard look. This supersedes DESIGN.md section 2's earlier 'original in-style only, not a replica' wording. Build the facade/yard assets in this manifest against REFERENCE.md details (glowing orange eye windows, tooth-plank mouth, KEEP AWAY / BEWARE lawn signs, gnarled trees, sagging porch).
setting_rule: The playable world is the FRONT YARD. The house is a background facade at the north end (Z 23-30) and is not enterable in v1. Casino/bot functions from DESIGN.md sections 3 and 5 are dressed into the yard and porch, keeping their exact DESIGN names, positions, and clearances.
naming_rule: design_name = the exact object name from DESIGN.md sections 3/5; scripts and bot stations reference these character-for-character. proposed_name = true means DESIGN.md describes the item but gives it no name, so this manifest proposes one - it is NOT a DESIGN name. Every seated item needs an Anchor Point in Studio or avatars cannot sit on it (ASSETS.md section 5).

source_types.CAT-FREE: Highrise Asset Catalog, free low-poly range (specific price only visible inside Studio)
source_types.CAT-GOLD?: Asset Catalog, may require Gold - check price in Studio before use, never buy without the user's OK
source_types.UNITY: Built from Unity/Studio primitives, lights, and materials - no catalog download
source_types.BUILT-IN: Ships with the Highrise Studio Package
source_types.CUSTOM: Custom/imported asset - only if the stock + primitives route fails; do not block the build on these

facade.name: Facade_DoorMouth
facade.description: The front door and porch opening shaped and lit like a MOUTH - the bottom half of the mad face. Dark doorway, warm light spilling out, door slightly ajar.

INDOOR-TO-YARD REGROUPING: ASSETS.md was written for an indoor casino lounge (Zones A-F). Per DESIGN section 2 the playable world is the front yard with the house as a background facade (Z 23-30). Manifest regroups everything into front_yard / facade / poker / blackjack / trivia / radio / rps / vip_porch, re-dresses the lounge (Zone C) pieces as yard social seating in front_yard, and the VIP mezzanine (Zone F) as the raised VIP porch - while keeping every DESIGN section 3/5 object name, position, and clearance unchanged.
